interactions.label: FINGERPOST
interactions.dialog: THISTLECOMBE, EAST, 2 MILES. VINEHALLOW, UP THE HILL. THE MILL, SOUTH-WEST BY THE RIVER. BRAMBLEFORD, BACK OVER THE BRIDGE.

interactions.label: POST BOX
interactions.dialog: A RED PILLAR BOX. COLLECTION: WHEN THE MAIL COACH FEELS LIKE IT.

interactions.label: THE OLD OAK
interactions.dialog: A BENCH ROUND THE OAK AT THE CROSSROADS. FROM HERE YOU CAN SEE THE CHALK HORSE ON THE HILL, AND ON A CLEAR DAY THE SPIRE AT THISTLECOMBE.

interactions.label: TROUGH
interactions.prompt: PRESS E TO FILL THE CAN

interactions.label: GLASSHOUSE
interactions.dialog: TRAYS OF SEEDLINGS, A VINE OF SWEET PEAS UP THE WALL, A RADIO PLAYING TO THE TOMATOES.

interactions.label: WINDPUMP
interactions.dialog: IT CREAKS ROUND IN THE BREEZE, PUMPING WATER UP FOR THE FLOWERS.

interactions.label: THE ORCHARD
interactions.dialog: OLD CIDER APPLES: KINGSTON BLACK, BROWN SNOUT, SLACK-MA-GIRDLE. THE TREES ARE ALL ELBOWS.

interactions.label: THE LEVEL CROSSING
interactions.dialog: WHITE GATES SWUNG BACK FROM THE LANE. "STOP, LOOK, LISTEN." THE RAILS RUN NORTH TO BRAMBLEFORD AND SOUTH TO THISTLECOMBE.

interactions.label: DUCK POND
interactions.dialog: A DUCK POND BY THE LANE, A WILLOW TRAILING IN IT. THE DUCKS HAVE OPINIONS ABOUT YOU.

interactions.label: THE CHALK HORSE
interactions.dialog: CUT INTO THE HILL, WHITE AGAINST THE GREEN, OLDER THAN ANYONE KNOWS. EVERY SPRING THE VILLAGES SCOUR IT CLEAN TOGETHER.

interactions.label: MARIGOLD
interactions.dialog: MARIGOLD LARKIN LOOKS UP FROM A BUCKET OF DAHLIAS.

interactions.label: EZRA
interactions.dialog: EZRA COBB WIPES HIS HANDS ON HIS SMOCK.
